name: Fire
qualities: Passion, energy, courage, transformation, willpower, creativity
description: Fire represents passion, energy, and transformation. It is the element of willpower, courage, and creativity. Fire burns away the old to make room for the new.

name: Water
qualities: Emotion, intuition, healing, purification, flow, love
description: Water represents emotions, intuition, and healing. It is the element of love, purification, and the subconscious. Water flows and adapts, teaching us to move with life.

name: Air
qualities: Intellect, communication, knowledge, clarity, freedom, inspiration
description: Air represents intellect, communication, and knowledge. It is the element of the mind, clarity, and inspiration. Air brings new ideas and fresh perspectives.

name: Earth
qualities: Stability, grounding, abundance, fertility, strength, prosperity
description: Earth represents stability, grounding, and abundance. It is the element of the physical world, prosperity, and growth. Earth keeps us rooted and provides all we need.

name: Spirit
qualities: Unity, divine connection, transcendence, balance, wholeness
description: Spirit (or Akasha) represents the divine spark within all things. It is unity, transcendence, and the connection between all elements. Spirit binds everything together.
